text:
Commander night at Alex's house on Moraga Way in Orinda, Friday 28 August. Three-player pod: me, Alex, Stuart. Game four of four, and the only win of the night. Funniest game of the year.

Ramped through the early removal. The table spent its wipes on my mid-tier dinosaurs and I rebuilt faster than they could answer, which meant that when my board was empty I could fire BLASPHEMOUS ACT to clear THEIRS at no cost to me. That asymmetry was the whole game.

Then Gishath. Swung at Stuart for 7, revealed 7 cards off the trigger, hit FIVE dinosaurs — one of which makes their creatures enter tapped, so the board could not stabilise.

Next turn I drew Enlarge: +7/+7 on Gishath, swinging for 14 into Stuart's existing 7 commander damage = 21 and lethal by commander damage. Revealed 14 off that trigger, hit 2 more dinosaurs, one of which refilled my hand.

THE TABLE MISJUDGED THREAT TIERS. They spent their wraths on mid-tier dinosaurs and had nothing left when the commander landed. The deck's actual threat is the commander and the trigger, and my mid-tier bodies were effectively soaking removal for it.

No changes. This is the deck working as designed.
